other.tags: Progressive metal with math rock influences. Features dual clean electric guitars playing intricate, interlocking tapping patterns and polyrhythmic arpeggios. A five-string active bass guitar follows the kick drum with percussive slap techniques and rapid sixteenth-note runs. The drum kit utilizes a double-kick pedal for constant 16th-note patterns, a high-tuned snare with ghost notes, and frequent use of china and splash cymbals for accents. The track transitions between clean, math-rock inspired sections and heavy, distorted djent-style breakdowns using low-tuned seven-string guitars. Tempo is 140 BPM. Key is E minor. Time signatures shift frequently between 4/4, 7/8, and 11/8.

bass.tags: Post-punk and gothic rock instrumental. A prominent, overdriven electric bass guitar plays a repetitive, melodic eighth-note riff in the upper register. A clean electric guitar with heavy chorus and delay effects enters with arpeggiated chords and occasional dissonant accents. The drum machine features a tight, dry snare and a steady kick pattern with sixteenth-note hi-hat embellishments. A dark, analog synthesizer pad provides sustained harmonic textures in the background. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of B minor. The arrangement focuses on the interplay between the driving bassline and the atmospheric guitar layers, utilizing a cold, cavernous reverb on the overall mix.

drums.tags: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated drum kit and distorted electric guitar. The track opens with a solo drum groove characterized by a heavy kick and crisp snare, followed by a rhythmic, palm-muted guitar riff. The guitar tone is saturated with high-gain distortion. The arrangement alternates between a driving 4/4 beat and sections with more complex, syncopated accents on the snare and cymbals. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns closely with a gritty, overdriven tone. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM in the key of E minor. The structure focuses on the interplay between the percussive guitar chugging and the dynamic drum fills.

vocals.tags: Cinematic ambient electronic track with a slow, evolving structure. The piece features a deep, resonant sub-bass synth that provides a steady low-end pulse. A granular, shimmering pad texture creates a wide stereo field, while a high-pitched, crystalline synth lead plays a minimalist, repeating four-note motif. Mid-range analog synth swells enter periodically with long attack and release times. A subtle, glitchy percussion layer consists of filtered white noise bursts and metallic clicks, avoiding a traditional drum kit. The arrangement uses heavy hall reverb and long delay tails to create a sense of vast space. The tempo is 72 BPM in the key of D minor, maintaining a 4/4 time signature throughout.
